skill_headers.frontmatter:
name: brief-expander
description: >
  Takes a minimal research idea (even one sentence) and expands it into a complete
  research brief that can drive the 10-skill pipeline. Performs web search, literature
  scanning, and field analysis to fill in problem statement, data assets, domain context,
  target venue, success criteria, comparators, adjacent fields, and evaluation design.
  Usage: /brief-expander "your research question or idea"
user-invocable: true
allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, Agent, Write

name: critic-revisor
description: >
  Autonomous adversarial critic-revisor loop on a LaTeX manuscript. Two parallel
  Opus reviews per round with differentiated angles (methodologist + applied/
  contextual reader); reviewers can web-search within a per-round budget; Codex
  CLI applies the combined review; latexmk rebuilds the clean PDF; latexdiff
  produces a color-tracked PDF. Repeats until both reviewers say accept, no diff
  is produced, the LaTeX build fails, or the round budget is exhausted. Saves
  per-round subfolders under critic_revisor_logs/. Paper-agnostic. Use when the
  user asks to "run the adversarial loop", "auto-revise the manuscript",
  "critic-revisor", or similar.
user-invocable: true
argument-hint: <manuscript.tex> [max_rounds=5] [venue] [--sources <paths>]
headings: ## What to tell the user when you finish

A system of 13 coordinated [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) skills that automate the full lifecycle of a research methodology paper — from idea to a polished, adversarially revised manuscript. Twelve skills form the autonomous pipeline, including **House Style**, an exemplar-based house voice judged by a reader-first read, with advisory style metrics; the thirteenth, the **Critic-Revisor**, is an optional adversarial-revision layer that runs on the resulting draft. **Domain-agnostic**: all domain knowledge lives in the research brief, not in the skills.

Two additional case studies using the biostatistics-specific version of these skills are available at [ARMS-Biostat](https://github.com/koaeraser/ARMS-Biostat):

Developed March 2026. The v1 system (simple write-grade-fix loop) identified the plateau problem; the v2 system was designed from scratch to address it. The 11 pipeline skills began as a biostatistics-specific pipeline ([ARMS-Biostat](https://github.com/koaeraser/ARMS-Biostat), KG-DAP run 2026-03-23), then were generalized to domain-agnostic form and first released here on 2026-03-24; the conformal prediction case study was produced the same day, as the first test of the generalized skills. The **Critic-Revisor** augmentation (now the 13th skill) was added on 2026-06-10. The **House Style** skill was added on 2026-09-25, after drafts that passed every tic check were still found to drift from the target voice. Its style metrics began as enforced bands and were made advisory the same day, when an approved exemplar abstract fell outside the sentence-length band; the exemplar and the reader-first read became the standard.

findings.title: Three invoked helper skills are absent
findings.details: failure-diagnoser, venue-compliance-gate, consistency-auditor are invoked but not shipped. Venue gate defaults off in SKILL (README example says on). Consistency audit is a required final gate.
findings.adaptation: Use separately labelled local replacement role documents with explicit provenance and existence checks, or report gate unavailable. Do not claim these are supplied upstream skills.

findings.title: Canonical shared scoring rubric is not shipped
findings.details: References ~/.claude/skills/_shared/scoring_rubric.md, absent. Embedded paper-grader scoring text exists, but is not proof of the absent canonical severity/escalation document.
findings.adaptation: Mark unavailable explicitly; retain embedded rubric as supplied, never fabricate the canonical document.

findings.title: Critic loop edits in place and automatically commits unrelated repository state
findings.details: Automatic git add -A and commit run on any enclosing Git repository. Snapshots protect main .tex/.pdf only; revisor may edit in place and failed builds do not roll back. Model processes have no wall-clock timeout.
findings.adaptation: Default Git snapshots off; explicit opt-in, clean-index precondition, bounded manuscript/run paths only. Check all prerequisites before outputs/models. Never run against preserved resources.

findings.title: Private installation paths and Claude APIs require adaptation
findings.details: Claude Read/Glob/Grep/Bash/Task/Agent/WebSearch/WebFetch and general-purpose subagent_type are host-specific. Private telemetry hook, skill-auditor, apply-proposal script, snapshots and macOS LaunchAgent are absent.
findings.adaptation: Resolve bundled skills relative to SKILL directory; execute from resolved absolute paths. Use host equivalents honestly; mark private services unavailable. Project pipeline outputs remain task-local.

findings.title: Case-study executable package is incomplete
findings.details: Scripts expect/create sibling validated_results, but shipped results are data/mve_production.csv and data/stress_all.csv, not mve_results.csv/stress_tests_combined.csv. Production/sensitivity/real-data/ablation/significance/conditional-coverage generators and raw Housing/Wine inputs are absent. NeurIPS 2025 style and compiled manuscript are absent.
findings.adaptation: Preserve as historical example. For a rerun copy full case to writable task workspace and configure output/input directories. Do not equate production data with 500-rep validation simply by renaming. Obtain missing official style/data and rebuild generators separately if reproduction is requested.

findings.title: Conflicting templates and historical narrative
findings.details: Root template has author exemplars/manuscript shape/contribution fields missing from skill-local template; skill template has statistics-specific defaults. DISCLAIMER describes absent clinical data/trials_data.csv and two biostatistics case studies. README markets domain-agnostic pipeline; pipeline scope is statistical/biostatistical methodology. Six historic validation iterations exceed present max-three instructions.
findings.adaptation: Use richer root template for new briefs while preserving both originals. Mark clinical disclaimer cross-repo provenance and historic results; do not advertise general-domain autonomous scientific validation.

findings.title: Numerical implementation assumptions must remain visible
findings.details: generate_mve_data accepts K but always creates five sources and assumes d>=4. Base model is fitted on the same source observations scored for calibration. Oracle label says test/ground-truth selection but caller supplies target calibration scores. Report CONDITIONAL GO accepts min coverage 0.840 while code marks min<0.85 NO-GO. Method validation of empty/nonfinite/negative input and alpha bounds is absent; RandomState(0) search fixed.
findings.adaptation: Treat code as demonstration, not general validated conformal library; document parameter domain and compare exact scripts/data before any new scientific claim. Formal deployed data-dependent-weight guarantee is acknowledged missing in manuscript.

findings.title: Style metrics are portable diagnostics with parser limits
findings.details: Stdlib only. Ignores paragraphs <=40 tokens, uses regex rather than TeX parser, does not follow input/include, locale-default decoding errors ignored. include-appendix still stops at bibliography, so appendices after bibliography are not included. --ref/--genre missing arguments can IndexError; unknown genre is unchecked; successful --gate always exits zero by design. Default full exemplar is not distributed.
findings.adaptation: Keep advisory. Supply accessible user exemplar with --ref. Do not interpret metric CLI success as manuscript, style or scientific approval.
